description: Screenshot: full, monitor, region, active or window (PrintWindow, works while covered). Returns the image. Capturing a minimized window restores it, so it needs bring_to_front after the user agreed.

bring_to_front.description: restore and activate the window first (takes the user's focus)

title.description: part of the window title (case-insensitive; an exact title wins) or a handle from list_windows (0x...)
